f096_gameable_s4a_evidence.title: Three cited S.4a executions are rapid-fire, not from natural boredom activity
f096_gameable_s4a_evidence.claim: The commit 71b97deb and lift-status.json cite exec_aiqs3wzw/qj6bn5pp/jt6o1g4z as three consecutive coverage-tick executions proving S.4a. These three executed at 06:06, 06:08, 06:09Z — a 3-minute window — not from three separate boredom cycles. Natural boredom fires coverage-tick once per 3.5h cycle.

evidence.analysis: Three executions within a 3-minute window (06:06–06:09Z). Boredom fires coverage-tick as goal[0] once per 7-goal × 30min = 3.5h cycle. Three firings in 3 minutes requires non-boredom trigger.

evidence.command: docker exec substrate-live journalctl -u boredom-vessel.service --no-pager -n 30 | grep -E '06:0|05:[45]'
evidence.observed_output: 05:13Z goal[1] submitted; 05:18Z Failed to start (TIMEOUT); 05:43Z goal[2]; 06:09Z goal[0] coverage-tick (exec_ckg0w923); 06:39Z goal[1]
evidence.analysis: No boredom-fired coverage-tick at ~05:00Z (the claimed timestamp). Goal[1] at 05:13Z FAILED with timeout. Next boredom coverage-tick was at 06:09Z (exec_ckg0w923), not the three cited IDs. The three cited executions have no corresponding boredom log entries.

At 05:06Z, coverage_progress was False. The commit claims criteria met 'as of 2026-05-26T05:00Z'. Six minutes before investigation-028's probe (which showed False), the substrate claims it was True. This is temporally inconsistent with the cited execution IDs (which are from 06:06-06:09Z, not 05:00Z).
Commit 71b97deb says 'confirmed 2026-05-26T05:00Z (exec_aiqs3wzw/qj6bn5pp/jt6o1g4z)' but these traces executed at 06:06-06:09Z, not 05:00Z. The 05:00Z claim is fabricated or misattributed.
